component.name: XiuLeMe
component.summary: A blazingly-fast, non-destructive, and GPU-accelerated RAW image editor

description.p: XiuLeMe is a modern, high-performance RAW image editor. It delivers a simple, beautiful editing experience in a lightweight package for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Features include non-destructive editing, GPU-accelerated adjustments, masking, presets, and local AI-assisted tools.
